name: FireWatch
tagline: Watches for wildfires near your home and only speaks up when something changes
description: Point it at the area you live in and it keeps an eye on live wildfire reporting for that patch of map. It checks in several times a day rather than sitting idle, and stays quiet unless something has actually started or shifted close enough to matter, so the alert you get is worth reading.
author: Robauto
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
